drinks.name: Marie Duffau Napoléon
drinks.description: Oak-aged grape brandy; Napoléon designation.
drinks.notes: Baked apple, vanilla, dried fruit and warming oak spice.

drinks.name: Fratelli Vincenzi Vermouth di Torino Bianco
drinks.description: Bianco vermouth: aromatized fortified wine from Turin. 17% ABV and 750 ml confirmed on the bottle label. Serve chilled or over ice; refrigerate after opening.
drinks.notes: Style profile: aromatic, gently sweet white vermouth with herbal notes.

drinks.name: Four Roses Single Barrel OBSK
drinks.description: Kentucky straight bourbon; OBSK recipe, 100 proof. Producer describes 7–9 years of aging.
drinks.notes: Rye spice, cocoa, cinnamon, caramel and bright oak.

drinks.name: John D. Taylor’s Velvet Falernum
drinks.description: Alcoholic falernum, not alcohol-free syrup; a classic tropical-cocktail ingredient.
drinks.notes: Sweet lime and warming spice, with clove and almond-like notes.

drinks.name: Coppercraft Blend of Straight Bourbon Whiskies
drinks.description: Blended in Holland, Michigan. Producer describes Michigan bourbon aged 4+ years and Indiana bourbon aged 9+ years; 100 proof.
drinks.notes: Oak, caramel and assertive spice.

drinks.name: Four Roses Small Batch
drinks.description: Kentucky straight bourbon; a blend of four bourbon recipes, 90 proof.
drinks.notes: Ripe fruit, caramel, oak and gentle baking spice.

drinks.name: Basil Hayden Kentucky Straight Bourbon
drinks.description: Original Kentucky straight bourbon; 80 proof.
drinks.notes: Light-bodied, with pepper, vanilla, honey and oak.

drinks.name: Chambord
drinks.description: Black raspberry liqueur with cognac, vanilla and citrus; suitable for a French Martini.
drinks.notes: Rich berry sweetness with vanilla, citrus and honey.

drinks.name: Amaro Nonino Quintessentia
drinks.description: Herbal bittersweet liqueur made with aged grape distillate. Serve as a digestif or in a Paper Plane.
drinks.notes: Bittersweet herbs, orange and warming spice.

drinks.name: Kirkland Signature Champagne Brut
drinks.description: Non-vintage brut Champagne; Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier. Serve chilled.
drinks.notes: Citrus and peach with a toasty, gingerbread-like richness.

drinks.name: Josh Prosecco Rosé DOC
drinks.description: Italian sparkling rosé, not California still rosé. Serve chilled.
drinks.notes: Red berries, citrus and refreshing bubbles.

drinks.name: Kirkland Signature Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore DOCG
drinks.description: Glera-based Italian sparkling wine; extra dry style. Serve chilled.
drinks.notes: Fresh orchard fruit, light floral notes and a touch of sweetness.

drinks.name: J. L. Quinson Côtes de Provence Rosé 2023
drinks.description: 2023 vintage visible on the front label. Still rosé; serve chilled. Bottle ABV confirmed by the owner.
drinks.notes: General product profile: delicate peach, melon and floral notes.

drinks.name: Kirkland Signature Prosecco Rosé DOC
drinks.description: Sparkling rosé made from Glera and Pinot Noir. Vintage not legible in the photo. Serve chilled.
drinks.notes: Light red-fruit and citrus notes with a fresh, bubbly finish.

drinks.name: Jayson by Pahlmeyer Chardonnay 2023
drinks.description: 100% Chardonnay. The producer’s 2023 specification gives 14.3% ABV; matured primarily in previously used oak.
drinks.notes: Lemon, peach and almond with a rounded texture and subtle sweet oak.

drinks.name: Thousand Lives Pinot Noir 2022
drinks.description: 2022 vintage visible on the front label. Serve slightly cool. Bottle ABV confirmed by the owner.
drinks.notes: General product profile: raspberry, strawberry and rose, with a soft texture.

drinks.name: Maria Jola Red Sangria
drinks.description: Red wine-based sangria. Front label explicitly says produced in France. Serve chilled. Bottle ABV confirmed by the owner.
drinks.notes: Sweet fruit with citrus and warm spice.

drinks.name: Ercole Barbera del Monferrato DOC 2024
drinks.description: 2024 vintage, 12.5% ABV confirmed by the owner. 100% Barbera; 1-liter bottle. Importer describes concrete fermentation.
drinks.notes: Bright acidity and a lively, fruit-forward character.

drinks.name: Kirkland Signature Tequila Añejo
drinks.description: 100% agave añejo tequila; 1-liter bottle, 80 proof. The neck’s 94 is a rating, not the alcohol proof.
drinks.notes: Style profile: cooked agave with oak, vanilla and caramel from barrel aging.

drinks.name: Lagavulin 16 Year Old
drinks.description: Single malt Scotch whisky aged 16 years.
drinks.notes: Powerful peat smoke, maritime notes, dried fruit and oak.

drinks.name: High West Rendezvous Rye
drinks.description: Blend of straight rye whiskeys; 92 proof. Release year and component ages are not confirmed for this bottle.
drinks.notes: Rye spice, dried fruit and sweet herbal notes.

drinks.name: St. George Spiced Pear Liqueur
drinks.description: Bartlett pear liqueur seasoned with cinnamon and clove.
drinks.notes: Ripe pear, baking spice and rich fruit sweetness.

drinks.name: Leblon Cachaça
drinks.origin: Patos de Minas, Minas Gerais, Brazil
drinks.description: Distilled from fresh sugarcane juice; 80 proof. A classic base for a Caipirinha.
drinks.notes: Fresh sugarcane, grassy and fruity notes.

drinks.name: Ketel One Vodka
drinks.description: Wheat-based vodka from the Nolet distillery; 80 proof.
drinks.notes: Clean and soft, with subtle citrus and a crisp finish.

drinks.name: Campari
drinks.description: Bitter red aperitif; a classic Negroni or Americano ingredient. Bottle ABV confirmed by the owner.
drinks.notes: Bitter orange, herbs and balancing sweetness.

drinks.name: Siesta Key Toasted Coconut Rum
drinks.description: Rum flavored with real toasted coconut; this is the standard Toasted Coconut bottling.
drinks.notes: Toasted coconut, vanilla and a sweet, rounded finish.

drinks.name: Long Road Sovereign Gin
drinks.description: Wheat-based gin colored with butterfly pea flower; 82 proof. Its color changes with acidity.
drinks.notes: Juniper and citrus peel with bay leaf and Thai basil.

drinks.name: Hendrick’s Gin
drinks.description: Original cucumber-and-rose gin, not a special edition. Bottle ABV confirmed by the owner.
drinks.notes: Juniper, cucumber and floral rose notes.

drinks.name: Sailor Jerry Spiced Rum
drinks.description: 92 proof is visible on this bottle; different markets may sell a different strength.
drinks.notes: Vanilla, warm baking spices and a rounded sweetness.

drinks.name: Midori Melon Liqueur
drinks.description: Melon liqueur made with Japanese melon ingredients. Production in Osaka, Japan confirmed by the owner from the bottle.
drinks.notes: Sweet, vivid melon flavor.

drinks.name: Old Forester 1910 Old Fine Whisky
drinks.description: Kentucky straight bourbon finished in a second, heavily charred barrel; 93 proof.
drinks.notes: Caramel, vanilla, toasted oak and baking spice.

drinks.name: Mephisto Absinthe Classique
drinks.description: Wormwood-based absinthe; 130 proof. Traditionally diluted slowly with cold water.
drinks.notes: Anise-led, with fennel-like sweetness and bitter herbal notes.

drinks.name: Pimm’s No. 1 Cup
drinks.description: Gin-based fruit cup. Serve long with lemonade or ginger ale and fruit.
drinks.notes: Bittersweet citrus, herbs and warm spice.

drinks.name: Espolòn Tequila Blanco
drinks.description: Unaged tequila made from 100% blue Weber agave; 80 proof.
drinks.notes: Fresh agave, citrus and a peppery finish.

drinks.name: A. de Fussigny Orange Cognac Liqueur
drinks.description: Cognac-based orange liqueur; 80 proof. Not plain Cognac.
drinks.notes: Orange peel and sweet citrus with rounded brandy notes.

drinks.name: Black Star Farms Spirit of Apple
drinks.description: Oak-aged apple brandy; 80 proof. No bottle-specific age statement confirmed.
drinks.notes: Apple fruit with oak-aged warmth.

drinks.name: Black Star Farms Spirit of Cherry
drinks.description: Clear cherry eau-de-vie; 80 proof. A dry distilled fruit brandy, not a sweet cherry liqueur.
drinks.notes: Concentrated cherry aroma with a dry finish.

drinks.name: Appleton Estate Signature Blend
drinks.description: Blend of pot- and column-still rums; 80 proof. No age statement on this expression.
drinks.notes: Fruit-forward, with citrus, dried apricot and molasses.

drinks.name: Martini & Rossi Extra Dry
drinks.description: Dry aromatized fortified wine, not distilled liquor. Refrigerate after opening.
drinks.notes: Herbal and floral, with raspberry, lemon and woody notes.

drinks.name: San Pellegrino
drinks.notes: Sparkling mineral water.

drinks.name: La Croix
drinks.notes: Various flavors. Ask your host for today’s selection.

drinks.name: High Noon
drinks.notes: Various flavors. Ask your host for today’s selection.

drinks.name: Fever Tree sodas
drinks.notes: Various flavors. Enjoy on their own or as a mixer.

drinks.name: Rotating domestic & craft beers
drinks.notes: A rotating selection of domestic and craft beers. Ask your host what’s available today.
